name: comp-327
title: Invite Members Dialog
description: A trigger opens a dark dialog where you can add several teammate emails, send invites, and copy a read-only magic link with a one-click copy button.
use: You want to invite several teammates by email or share a referral link from one dialog.
avoid: Sending is not wired and the magic link is a fixed example URL.
a11y: The copy button is labelled and focus moves to the last email, but the email label is not bound to those inputs. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Closed, an outlined Invite members button. Open, a tall dark rounded dialog: a circled person-plus icon, a bold left-aligned title and grey subtitle, three stacked email fields, an underlined + Add another, a white full-width Send invites, a divider, and a read-only magic link field with a copy icon.
behaves: Opening focuses the empty email field. Add another appends a row, the copy icon copies the link and flips to a green check for a moment, and Send invites does nothing.
customise: Seeded emails, the magic link URL and all labels are hardcoded; adding a row is the only live behaviour.
weight: light: One dialog with a short email array and a clipboard call.
